entities.name: Additional GUTI
entities.description: An optional information element that may be included in certain attach procedures when specific conditions are met.

entities.name: TIN indicates P-TMSI
entities.description: Condition where the Temporary Identity used in Next update (TIN) parameter indicates P-TMSI.

entities.name: UE holds valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI
entities.description: Condition where the UE possesses valid GUTI, P-TMSI and Routing Area Identity.

entities.name: UE configured for AttachWithIMSI
entities.description: Condition where the UE is configured for AttachWithIMSI as specified in 3GPP TS 24.368 or 3GPP TS 31.102.

entities.name: Attaching in new PLMN not registered or equivalent
entities.description: Condition where the UE is attaching in a new PLMN that is neither the registered PLMN nor in the list of equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: Include Additional GUTI IE
entities.description: Behavior where the UE includes the Additional GUTI information element in the message.

entities.name: Exclude Additional GUTI IE
entities.description: Behavior where the UE does not include the Additional GUTI information element in the message.

relations.description: The include property results in the Additional GUTI IE being present in the message.
The exclude property results in the Additional GUTI IE being absent from the message.
Condition where TIN indicates P-TMSI guards the inclusion of the Additional GUTI IE.
Condition where UE holds valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI guards the inclusion of the Additional GUTI IE.
Condition where UE is configured for AttachWithIMSI guards the exclusion of the Additional GUTI IE.
Condition where UE is attaching in a new PLMN that is neither registered nor equivalent guards the exclusion of the Additional GUTI IE.
